details.nl: 每个季度内部销售额排名前3的省份
details.gold_sql: SELECT t.quarter, t.province, t.gmv FROM (SELECT d.quarter, r.province, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS gmv, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY d.quarter ORDER BY SUM(f.order_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.quarter, r.province) t WHERE t.rn <= 3 ORDER BY t.quarter, t.gmv DESC
details.agent_sql:
WITH province_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.quarter AS quarter,
        r.province AS province,
        SUM(o.order_amount) AS gmv
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id = d.date_id
    JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
    GROUP BY d.quarter, r.province
),
ranked_province AS (
    SELECT
        quarter,
        province,
        gmv,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rnk
    FROM province_sales
)
SELECT
    quarter,
    province,
    gmv
FROM ranked_province
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY quarter, rnk;

details.category: 窗口函数 LAG 环比
details.nl: 各季度GMV及环比增长率
details.gold_sql: SELECT t.quarter, t.gmv, ROUND((t.gmv - t.prev_gmv) / t.prev_gmv * 100, 2) AS growth_pct FROM (SELECT d.quarter, SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv, LAG(SUM(f.order_amount)) OVER(ORDER BY MIN(d.date_id)) AS prev_gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.quarter) t ORDER BY t.quarter
details.agent_sql:
WITH quarterly_gmv AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(LEFT(d.date_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS order_year,
        d.quarter,
        SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv
    FROM fact_order f
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
    GROUP BY CAST(LEFT(d.date_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED), d.quarter
),
gmv_with_prev AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        quarter,
        gmv,
        LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, FIELD(quarter, 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4')) AS prev_gmv
    FROM quarterly_gmv
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    quarter,
    gmv,
    CASE
        WHEN prev_gmv IS NULL OR prev_gmv = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (gmv - prev_gmv) / prev_gmv * 100
    END AS gmv_qoq_growth_rate
FROM gmv_with_prev
ORDER BY order_year, FIELD(quarter, 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4');
